- SPIFFE IDs and mutual TLS authentication

```bash
consul acl token read -self

# Monitor WAN gossip and certificate debugging

```

- What metrics would you collect to prevent recurrence of cross-DC failures?
- How do you ensure zero-downtime debugging in a multi-datacenter environment?
